main_text.p: tor, qui ut Heroum fortitudinem imitari videatur, nulli periculo imparium, hic arduum Phyfico-Medicis certamen minatur, ac thrafonice infurgit, aggreffus materiam, in qua perfpicaciffimos coecutire pronunciat Spe&temus hujufce gladiatorios ictus. Age, inquit, o Critice, qui fuperfluitionem hic arguis: oftende ubi lateat, cedo pastum cum Damone tacitum vel expref-fum: an illud intervenifle inter curationis autorem cenfes? hem! quam parum folide! unde & qua ratione iftu d colligis? ergo qui primus rhabarbaro, agarico, & aliis catharticis corpora purgavit, qui paeonia appenfa morbum comitialem profligavit, fortilegum Daemonologum ve cenfes? fi hoc negas, & iftud nego. Denique cedo authorem, cedo tempus, cedo locum, quo pactum hoc initum: fane effectus naturales cacodaemoni imponere, ubi rationes non defunt, quae caufam detegant, inertis & ftolidi ingenii eft, inquit, annon.

page.notes: Printed text is partly rough; the words "Spe&temus" and "pastum"/"pactum" are uncertain readings. The "[?]" marks were not added where the scan is legible enough; the catchword "annon." is read as printed at the foot right.
